comment: Laya typed question pack — page-recognition assist. Called only when the code-computed anchor-match confidence lands in the confirm band (site drift, minor redesign). It is a second opinion, never the primary matcher: the URL hard gate and anchor scoring run first in code.
state: the registered page's anchor criteria (selectors and expected text) plus the live snapshot's element list and text

is_expected_page.instructions: Does this live page show the same content the criteria describe, despite changes in wording or layout?

needs_reregistration.instructions: Has the page changed so much that the vendor flow needs to be re-registered by the caregiver?

app_policy.confirm_band: 0.50-0.85 → stop, surface to the user: 'This page looks different than usual.'
app_policy.abort_band: < 0.50, or needs_reregistration >= 0.5 → abort flow, notify caregiver to re-register the vendor
